description: Points a host (e.g. www) at the i9labs Sites edge with a CNAME, and optionally adds the Cloudflare for SaaS ownership (_cf-custom-hostname) and certificate validation (_acme-challenge) TXT records Cloudflare asks for while the custom hostname is pending. Apply with host set; the CNAME cannot sit at the apex. Group edge = the CNAME; ownership, dcv and dcv2 = the TXT records (Cloudflare may issue two DCV tokens), applied only when the service passes a value for them.
variableDescription: %target%: the site's edge hostname, e.g. s-1a2b3c4d5e6f.allhyipdata.com (issued per site by our hosting platform); %cfowner%: Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostname ownership verification token; %cfdcv%: Cloudflare certificate (DCV) TXT validation token; %cfdcv2%: the second DCV TXT token, when Cloudflare issues two
